case.name: Order Status Lookup
case.business_problem: Let customers check the current status of an existing order without contacting support.
case.desired_outcome: Instant, accurate order status for the customer, with zero support-ticket volume for this question.
case.quality_target: 100% match with the order-management system's current status
case.regulatory_constraints: Standard data-access logging; no new regulatory exposure
case.roi_notes: Illustrative assumptions, not measurements: Efficiency: removes an entire support-ticket category (~2 minutes/ticket) via self-service. Solution cost: effectively just existing API infrastructure, no model cost.

tradeoff_notes: An LLM wrapper adds latency, cost and a hallucination risk for a question the order-management API already answers exactly; there is no quality upside to buy. Revisit only if scope grows to open-ended natural-language questions about the order (e.g. "why is my order late") that the API alone can't answer.
